bio: The expertise of chef Kasper Verlinden and maître d'/sommelier Remco van Antwerpen is palpable at Portfolio and testament to their combined wealth of experience. Meticulously prepared and ambitious, their original creations live up to high expectations. Fish, seafood and Asian flavour nuances are the name of the game here. Expressive, technically sophisticated, captivating. All that deliciousness is also enhanced by a magnificent selection of natural wines and some very appealing non-alcoholic options....
